parameters.prompt: Wide 16:9 view from the audience seats toward a stage. Five characters stand in a row, left to right: a pale-blue teardrop robot floating over a glowing floor ring, a halo above, in a gray knit sweater; a round orange robot with a cream belly, round gold glasses and an amber antenna light; a round lime robot on coiled-spring legs with chunky boots and a small lightning bolt, grinning; a doll-like android in a royal-blue tee with thick black glasses and a gold chain; and a person in a homemade costume: a teal cardboard box over the head with eye slots and a drawn smile, a ping-pong-ball antenna, a red and cream knit scarf, jeans and sneakers. A small table holds a giant milkshake and a toy ray gun. Backs of audience robots' heads at the bottom. Game UI: a dark plum panel with a thin gold border top left, a cream paper card top right, a speech bubble above the orange robot, all with blank lines, no text. Vintage tin-toy style: the robots are 1950s wind-up tin toys in glossy enamel paint, rounded pressed-metal shapes, rivets, wind-up keys; the costumed person looks homemade beside them. A 1960s live-studio TV soundstage: a painted flat in a wooden frame, studio spotlights on stands, a boom mic, a vintage TV camera on a dolly, an unlit red lamp, wooden bleachers of small tin audience robots. Cream, mint and warm orange with chrome highlights. Warm tungsten light, soft shadows. Clean readable silhouettes.
